title: Chilean temporary residence for nationals of the Mercosur Residence Agreement states (Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Paraguay, Uruguay)

sources.title: Ley N.º 21.325 (migration law), published 2021-04-20, article 70: temporary residence subcategories, among them N.º 9, treaties, and N.º 13, reciprocity or other treaties
Ley N.º 21.325, article 74: dependents (spouse or partner; children of the resident, spouse or partner under 18, disabled, or from 18 to under 24 and studying) and the principal's means
Decreto N.º 177/2022, articles 72 to 74: dependents' permits, proof of the tie, the principal's notarized sworn statement and means by the Social Development and Family Ministry's indicators
Servicio Nacional de Migraciones: Mercosur temporary residence (subcategory 15) for citizens of Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Paraguay and Uruguay, up to two years, applied for from abroad
Servicio Nacional de Migraciones: dependents of a temporary resident, their documents, and the principal's means measured against the Social Development Ministry's indicators
Civil Code: art. 26, of age at 18 (dieciocho años); art. 48, a period of years started on a day the end month lacks ends on its last day, which also applies to ages
Mercosur, Bolivia and Chile Residence Agreement, as approved by Paraguay's Ley N.º 3578/2008, article 2: nationals by origin, or by naturalization held for five years
Mercosur, Bolivia and Chile Residence Agreement, as approved by Paraguay's Ley N.º 3578/2008, article 4.1: a temporary residence of up to two years, on the documents listed
Mercosur Residence Agreement (Paraguay's Ley N.º 3578/2008), article 4.1, c): no judicial, criminal or police records in the country of origin or where one lived in the 5 years before
Servicio Nacional de Migraciones: migration fees; temporary residence for foreigners in general by the fee table by nationality, and the dollar value used for the calculation
Ministry of the Interior, Resolución Exenta N.º 129194 of 2020-07-03 (linked by the service as its fee table by nationality): residence fees in US dollars, paid in pesos; temporary residence column
Servicio Nacional de Migraciones, news of 2023-09-20: the Chile–Bolivia migration cooperation agreement removes the temporary residence fee (USD 90 charged to Bolivians)
Decreto N.º 296 of 1995 (fees foreigners pay), article 2: fees equal the consular tariff, by reciprocity, in pesos; fifteen dollars for dependents (d); girls, boys and adolescents exempt

requirements.title: National by origin of Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Paraguay or Uruguay, or naturalized there for five years or more

assessments.title: When family members apply as dependents, the principal signs a notarized sworn statement to bear their costs and shows enough means by the Social Development and Family Ministry's indicators
Adults show a criminal record certificate from the country of origin or where they lived in the last 5 years, attached within 60 days of issue; the origin country's is valid 60 days at most
Fee by nationality, in US dollars paid in pesos at the official rate: Argentina 250, Brazil 100, Paraguay 288, Uruguay 65; Bolivians none since a 2023-09 agreement (before, 149 or 90); minors exempt
Applied for from abroad only, online on the migration service's digital procedures portal; family members apply as dependents the same way
Passport valid for a year or more from the application (a Bolivian may use a valid identity card); a recent photo; foreign papers apostilled or legalized, and translated unless in Spanish or English
Dependents prove the tie (marriage or cohabitation proof, birth certificate); a child under 18 adds a parent's notarized care statement, and a stepchild the couple's marriage or cohabitation proof

dependents.title: The principal's children under 18; older children only with a disability, or 18 or older and under 24 and studying at an institution the State recognizes, neither of which is recorded: possible
The spouse's children under 18; older children only with a disability, or 18 or older and under 24 and studying at an institution the State recognizes, neither of which is recorded: possible
The partner's children under 18; older children only with a disability, or 18 or older and under 24 and studying at an institution the State recognizes, neither of which is recorded: possible

costs.title: USD 15 for each dependent of 18 or over, the fee table's flat fee for residence as a dependent, paid in Chilean pesos at the official dollar rate; minors are exempt

durations.title: Mercosur temporary residence: up to two years
